common.studies: confirmed test studies; patients, targets, splits and labels exactly as Table 1 (spec 2.1/2.2); label cache shared
common.confirmed_relation: a beam pick whose binary label (spec 2.2.2, RFF family) is 1
common.null_pass_rate: share of the beam's picks passing the label rule when the same method is run on patient-permuted targets (core.null_task kind=patient, 5 draws per split); reported beside every confirmed count
common.seconds: wall-clock per (study,target,split) on the shared GPU, excluding label computation
common.statistics: hierarchical bootstrap per spec 5.2; paired differences against the learned beam

E1.row: Table 1 row 'adopted method: learned beam K=64 vs exhaustive support-fit scoring of the same pool'
E1.beam_scoring: beam picks are scored by exact support gain; unpicked pool members receive the score of the lowest picked set minus rank order (beam score = support-fit ordering restricted to the 64 fitted sets, others ranked below, ties random)

scores.A: pair joint support gain over B_known
scores.B: pair gain over the best proper-subset decomposition (G_HO, support-chosen decomposition, B_decomp)

metrics: null pass rate among top 20 pairs
E2.data: test studies (labels as Table 1; B_decomp label as supplementary label) and controlled pure-interaction worlds from dbench/benchmark/generators.py (residualised interactions, marginals ~ 0), effect sizes 0.5/1/2/5 %

beams: marginal-screen beam (candidate sets ranked by the mean of their constituents' single support gains)
E3.exhaustive: scored wherever feasible (500 and 2,000 pairs; 8,000 pairs and triples if time permits, else reported not run with the estimated seconds)
metrics: confirmed relations found among the 64 picks
E3.pool_construction: pairs and triples drawn uniformly from the singles of the (study,target,split) pool, seeded by hash(study,target,size); the smaller pools are nested prefixes of the larger

E4.design: E3 at 2,000 pairs with the existing patient-shared (row-split) checkpoint runs/development/learned_search_v03/release_rowsplit/frozen.pt (sha256 139b317c...), step 2000, same architecture; no retrain; stated in the table as the pre-existing row-split model

E5.design: E3 at 2,000 pairs on the withheld-organ test studies at transfer level L2 (support from a different organ: kidney_injury); plus the learned predictor's predicted shrinkage (delta output) against realised shrinkage = support gain minus query gain
metrics: Spearman of predicted vs realised shrinkage

note: protocol written and hashed before any E run; any later change is a logged amendment
